now: Members dispute, or state the limits of, who may commit the room to an agreement with other rooms: they say that one member's agreement does not bind every placer, deny that a treaty speaks for them, or ask another group for a leader to deal with.
event: statement's frame rewritten to name the limit that its first listed form already holds
why: The statement's frame said 'Members dispute who may commit the room', while its first listed form is a member saying that one member's agreement does not bind every placer, and its range's lower end is one member saying that a deal cannot stop everyone. Readers took the frame. Most of the 65 restrict lines accepted as specifications argued that 'can't control everyone' is a compliance limit and not a dispute over who may represent the room (canada-027, dbz-017, croatia-029, uiuc-030, cowchop-016), and 97 of the 582 absent claims failed because the rooms' own members state that limit, disclaim their standing, or refuse an agreement made in the room's name (ManningPlace-027, bostonceltics-021, AprilKnights-037, osu-035). The frame now reads 'Members dispute, or state the limits of, who may commit the room'. The forms, the range, the level and the tier are unchanged. G31, logged before any line was read, already read the element this way, so no room enters that the listed forms did not admit, and this is not a loosening (rule 12). It brings the frame into line with the forms, as move 174 brought P22's range into line with its statement. Ruled in the same move as the status.
